```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
source("tracks/first-draft-may2026/code/common_first_draft.R")

# ---- Toggles ----------------------------------------------------------------
save_tables <- FALSE   # set TRUE to write .tex files to tables_dir

# ---- Estimation choices (change in one place) -------------------------------
cl <- ~ RSSDID + zip5
```

```{r dict}
# Variable label dictionary used by every etable() call below.
# Extends var_labels (defined in common_first_draft.R).
table_dict <- c(
  var_labels,
  # First-stage labels
  deposit_exp_chg         = "Deposit expense change",
  factor_age_bin          = "Age bins",
  dividend_frac           = "Dividend recipients (frac)",
  college_frac            = "College educated (frac)",
  sophisticated_frac      = "Sophisticated households (frac)",
  `log(family_income)`    = "log(family income)",
  bank_hhi                = "Bank HHI",
  `log(bank_assets)`      = "log(bank assets)",
  population_density      = "Population density",
  trans_accts_frac_assets = "Transaction accts / assets",
  uninsured_deposits_frac = "Uninsured deposit share",
  time_deposits_assets    = "Time deposits / assets",
  # Outcome
  opening                 = "Branch opening (0/1)",
  # Fixed-effect components (fixest translates each side of `^`)
  RSSDID                  = "Bank",
  yr                      = "Year",
  state_fips              = "State",
  zip5                    = "Zip"
)
setFixest_dict(table_dict)
```

```{r load}
master_parts <- Sys.glob(file.path(data_dir, "master_bank_zip_year_*_part*.rds"))
dates        <- regmatches(master_parts, regexpr("\\d{8}", master_parts))
latest_date  <- max(dates)
master_parts <- sort(master_parts[dates == latest_date])
bc_path      <- load_latest(file.path(data_dir, "bank_cycle_first_stage_*.rds"))

dt <- rbindlist(lapply(master_parts, readRDS))
bc <- setDT(readRDS(bc_path))
```

```{r prep}
setorder(dt, RSSDID, zip5, yr)
dt[, n_branches_lag1    := shift(n_branches_bzt,    1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]
dt[, bank_in_state_lag1 := shift(bank_in_state_bzt, 1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]
dt[, share_bzt_lag1     := shift(share_bzt,         1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]
dt[, opening := as.integer(n_branches_bzt > n_branches_lag1)]

dt[, n_large_banks_zip      := sum(n_branches_bzt > 0L), by = .(yr, zip5)]
dt[, n_large_banks_zip_lag1 := shift(n_large_banks_zip, 1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]

dt[, g_dep_zip_t1_t3 := log1p(dep_zip_total_lag1) - log1p(dep_zip_total_lag3)]
dt[, g_hmda_t1_t3    := log1p(hmda_amt_lag1)      - log1p(hmda_amt_lag3)]
dt[, g_cra_t1_t3     := log1p(cra_amt_lag1)       - log1p(cra_amt_lag3)]
dt[, log_dep_zip_lag1    := log1p(dep_zip_total_lag1)]
dt[, log_avg_agi_lag1    := log(avg_agi_lag1)]
dt[, log_n_branches_lag1 := log1p(n_branches_lag1)]
dt[, hhi_lag1            := deposit_hhi_zip_lag1 / 10000]
dt[is.na(share_bzt_lag1), share_bzt_lag1 := 0]

dt[!is.na(int_exp_assets_share_undercut),
   high_IEA := as.integer(int_exp_assets_share_undercut > 0.5)]
dt[!is.na(rate_paying_adv),
   high_rate_paying := as.integer(rate_paying_adv > 0)]

dt[, size_bucket := assign_bucket(bank_assets)]
bc[, size_bucket := assign_bucket(bank_assets * 1000)]
```

d_big <- copy(ar_master[size_bucket == "ge_100bn"])

for (d in list(d_big, d_mid, d_sml)) {

}

```{r helpers}
# align_decimals -------------------------------------------------------------
# Post-process etable() tex output to align coefficients on the decimal point
# via siunitx S columns. Preamble must load siunitx with:
#   \usepackage{siunitx}
#   \sisetup{detect-all, input-symbols={()*},
#            table-align-text-after=false, table-align-text-before=false}
align_decimals <- function(tex, n_models, digits = 4) {
  fmt  <- sprintf("-1.%d", digits)
  scol <- strrep(sprintf("S[table-format=%s]", fmt), n_models)

  # 0. Keep only the tabular block. results_current.tex wraps \input{} in its
  #    own \begin{table}, so a second one from etable triggers "Not in outer
  #    par mode".
  tab_match <- regmatches(
    tex,
    regexpr("(?s)\\\\begin\\{tabular\\}.*?\\\\end\\{tabular\\}", tex, perl = TRUE)
  )
  if (length(tab_match) && nzchar(tab_match)) tex <- tab_match

  # 1. {lccc...} -> {lS[..]S[..]...}
  patt <- paste0("\\{l", strrep("c", n_models), "\\}")
  tex  <- sub(patt, paste0("{l", scol, "}"), tex, perl = TRUE)

  # 2. Brace-wrap fixest stars so S column treats $^{***}$ as trailing text.
  tex  <- gsub("(\\$\\^\\{\\*+\\}\\$)", "{\\1}", tex, perl = TRUE)

  # 3. Wrap any non-numeric cell (header OR body) in \multicolumn{1}{c}{...}
  #    so text headers ("Early-F"), Yes/No FE rows, and math-macro cells
  #    (e.g. $-7.93\times 10^{-5}$) don't trip the S column parser.
  lines  <- strsplit(tex, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_tab <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(lines)) {
    if (grepl("\\\\begin\\{tabular\\}", lines[i])) { in_tab <- TRUE; next }
    if (grepl("\\\\end\\{tabular\\}", lines[i]))   { in_tab <- FALSE; next }
    if (!in_tab || !grepl("(?<!\\\\)&", lines[i], perl = TRUE)) next
    # Skip whole-row \multicolumn{N}{l|c|r}{...} footnote/banner rows.
    if (grepl("^\\s*\\\\multicolumn\\{\\d+\\}\\{[lcr]\\}", lines[i], perl = TRUE)) next

    raw <- lines[i]
    m   <- regexpr("\\s*\\\\\\\\\\s*$", raw, perl = TRUE)
    if (m > 0) {
      ending <- regmatches(raw, m)
      body   <- substr(raw, 1, m - 1)
    } else {
      ending <- ""; body <- raw
    }
    # Split on unescaped & only.
    cells <- strsplit(body, "(?<!\\\\)&", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(cells) <= 1) next
    for (j in 2:length(cells)) {
      v <- trimws(cells[j])
      if (v == "" || grepl("\\\\multicolumn", v)) next
      # Skip cells that look numeric / siunitx-friendly. No backslash, no
      # letters, no thousands-separator commas (siunitx -1.D can't parse those).
      if (grepl("^[-+0-9.()*$^{}\\s]+$", v, perl = TRUE)) next
      cells[j] <- sprintf(" \\multicolumn{1}{c}{%s} ", v)
    }
    lines[i] <- paste0(paste(cells, collapse = "&"), ending)
  }
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}

# emit_table -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Display etable in chat; optionally write .tex to tables_dir.
# keep: NULL  -> show all coefficients (controls visible).
#       char  -> regex vector of coefs to keep; adds "Controls = Yes" row.
emit_table <- function(models, headers, file_stem,
                       keep  = NULL,
                       title = NULL) {
  hide   <- !is.null(keep)
  extra  <- if (hide) list("Controls" = rep("Yes", length(models))) else NULL

  print(etable(models, headers = headers,
               keep_raw   = keep,
               extralines = extra,
               digits     = 4,
               digits.stats = 3,
               fitstat    = ~ n + r2))

  if (isTRUE(save_tables)) {
    tex_out <- etable(models, headers = headers,
                      keep_raw   = keep,
                      extralines = extra,
                      digits     = 4,
                      digits.stats = 3,
                      fitstat    = ~ n + r2,
                      tex        = TRUE,
                      title      = title,
                      label      = paste0("tab:", file_stem))
    tex_out  <- paste(as.character(tex_out), collapse = "\n")
    tex_out  <- align_decimals(tex_out, n_models = length(models), digits = 4)
    out_path <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".tex"))
    writeLines(tex_out, out_path)
    cat("Wrote:", out_path, "\n")
  }
}

# Economic-magnitude stats below each table:
#   Mean of dependent variable + SD of key RHS, per column.
# treats:  character vector (one entry per model). Use "x" or "x:y" for
#          interactions; sd of the product is reported.
# dvs:     character vector of dep-var names, one per model.
# dts:     list of data.tables, one per model.
table_stats <- function(headers, dvs, treats, dts) {
  treat_sd <- function(d, treat) {
    if (grepl(":", treat, fixed = TRUE)) {
      parts <- strsplit(treat, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      x <- Reduce(`*`, lapply(parts, function(p) d[[p]]))
    } else {
      x <- d[[treat]]
    }
    sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  out <- data.table(
    Column        = headers,
    Treatment     = treats,
    `Mean(DV)`    = vapply(seq_along(dts), function(i)
      sprintf("%.4f", mean(dts[[i]][[dvs[i]]], na.rm = TRUE)), character(1)),
    `SD(treat)`   = vapply(seq_along(dts), function(i)
      sprintf("%.4f", treat_sd(dts[[i]], treats[i])), character(1)),
    N             = vapply(dts, function(d) format(nrow(d), big.mark = ","),
                           character(1))
  )
  print(knitr::kable(out, format = "pipe"))
}
```

## Deposit beta — first stage (bank-cycle data)

```{r fs-fmls}
fml_full <- deposit_exp_chg ~ factor_age_bin + dividend_frac + college_frac +
  log(family_income) + bank_hhi + log(bank_assets) + population_density +
  trans_accts_frac_assets + uninsured_deposits_frac + time_deposits_assets

fml_soph <- deposit_exp_chg ~ sophisticated_frac + factor_age_bin +
  log(family_income) + bank_hhi + log(bank_assets) + population_density +
  trans_accts_frac_assets + uninsured_deposits_frac + time_deposits_assets
```

```{r fs-pooled}
bc_e <- bc[cycle == "cycle_0406"]
bc_m <- bc[cycle == "cycle_1619"]
bc_l <- bc[cycle == "cycle_2224"]

fs_e_full <- feols(fml_full, bc_e, notes = FALSE)
fs_m_full <- feols(fml_full, bc_m, notes = FALSE)
fs_l_full <- feols(fml_full, bc_l, notes = FALSE)


fs_models  <- list(fs_e_full, fs_m_full, fs_l_full)
fs_headers <- c("Early-F","Mid-F","Late-F")

# First-stage: "controls" here ARE the spec; show only the focal demographic
# coefficients (sophisticated_frac for the S spec; for the F spec there is
# no single key coef — leave the small set of demographics visible).
emit_table(fs_models, fs_headers, "tab_first_stage",
           keep  = NULL,
           title = "Deposit beta first stage")
```

```{r fs-stats}
table_stats(
  headers = fs_headers,
  dvs     = rep("deposit_exp_chg", 6),
  treats  = c("dividend_frac","dividend_frac","dividend_frac",
              "sophisticated_frac","sophisticated_frac","sophisticated_frac"),
  dts     = list(bc_e, bc_m, bc_l, bc_e, bc_m, bc_l)
)
```

## Deposit beta — main regression

```{r beta-subsets}
d_big_b <- d_big[!is.na(deposit_beta) & is.finite(deposit_beta)]
d_mid_b <- d_mid[!is.na(deposit_beta) & is.finite(deposit_beta)]
d_sml_b <- d_sml[!is.na(deposit_beta) & is.finite(deposit_beta)]
d_big_b[, deposit_beta := winsor(deposit_beta), by = yr]
d_mid_b[, deposit_beta := winsor(deposit_beta), by = yr]
d_sml_b[, deposit_beta := winsor(deposit_beta), by = yr]
```

```{r beta-main}
m_beta_big <- feols(opening ~ deposit_beta + ..fc | ..fe, d_big_b, cluster = cl)
m_beta_mid <- feols(opening ~ deposit_beta + ..fc | ..fe, d_mid_b, cluster = cl)
m_beta_sml <- feols(opening ~ deposit_beta + ..fc | ..fe, d_sml_b, cluster = cl)

# Per user spec: this is the ONLY table that prints control coefficients.
emit_table(list(m_beta_big, m_beta_mid, m_beta_sml),
           headers = c(">=$100B","$10B-$100B","$1B-$10B"),
           file_stem = "tab_deposit_beta_main",
           keep  = NULL,
           title = "Branch opening on deposit beta — main")
```

```{r beta-stats}
table_stats(
  headers = c(">=$100B","$10B-$100B","$1B-$10B"),
  dvs     = rep("opening", 3),
  treats  = rep("deposit_beta", 3),
  dts     = list(d_big_b, d_mid_b, d_sml_b)
)
```

## Combined: deposit_beta x rate-paying advantage

```{r comb-subsets}
d_big_c <- d_big[!is.na(rate_paying_adv) & is.finite(rate_paying_adv) &
                 !is.na(high_IEA) &
                 !is.na(deposit_beta) & is.finite(deposit_beta)]
d_mid_c <- d_mid[!is.na(rate_paying_adv) & is.finite(rate_paying_adv) &
                 !is.na(high_IEA) &
                 !is.na(deposit_beta) & is.finite(deposit_beta)]
d_sml_c <- d_sml[!is.na(rate_paying_adv) & is.finite(rate_paying_adv) &
                 !is.na(high_IEA) &
                 !is.na(deposit_beta) & is.finite(deposit_beta)]
for (d in list(d_big_c, d_mid_c, d_sml_c)) {
  d[, rate_paying_adv  := winsor(rate_paying_adv), by = yr]
  d[, deposit_beta     := winsor(deposit_beta),    by = yr]
  d[, high_rate_paying := as.integer(rate_paying_adv > 0)]
}
```

```{r combd}
m09_rp_big  <- feols(opening ~ deposit_beta * high_rate_paying + ..fc | ..fe, d_big_c, cluster = cl)

```
